        if not os.path.exists(dir_name):
            os.makedirs(dir_name, 0o700)
        else:

        frontend.setsockopt(zmq.SUBSCRIBE, b'')

        # Socket facing services
        backend = context.socket(zmq.PUB)
        backend.bind(
